fields.FIR_Description: The reported incident took place on 2025-09-06 (morning, 09:25): The complainant reported that a shop near Vaigai Layout Market Road was occupied without a valid agreement and the occupant refused to leave. Bhuvana Bai reported the matter orally at Tiruppur North PS; the contact number given was 9000000344. The complaint refers to Vasanth Mani, a driver, reachable on 9000000382. The complaint mentions Chithra Kannan, who was reportedly contacted on 9000000146, in connection with the events. Harish Babu (9000000422) noticed the incident and may be able to provide a statement.
fields.Modus_Operandi: Occupant reportedly refused to vacate despite repeated requests.
